# Hollywood Sales Wire

> Hollywood Sales Wire is a weekly sales-intelligence briefing for vendors selling into the entertainment industry. Every Tuesday it reports live buying signals — who just got funded, what they're about to buy, and when the purchasing window closes — sourced from public filings, state film tax-credit award lists, and hiring signals. Published by Karilyn Colegrove.

## Key facts

- Delivery: every Tuesday by email; plus a monthly strategic issue, The Divergence Report (12 per year).
- Individual membership: $1,150/year.
- Team membership (up to 5 seats): $2,300/year.
- Special Reports included with membership: The Spend Map, The $6.6 Billion Greenlight Window, and The Requisition Read ($119 each; $357 total value).
- Founding prices are available only through a valid offer link: $599/year or $64.99/month for an individual; $1,198/year or $129.98/month for a Team of up to 5 seats.
- Guarantee: 90-day money-back guarantee — full refund if the briefing hasn't produced live, workable prospects, and the reader keeps everything delivered.
- Free option: a weekly free edition summarizes each week's signals without the names, contacts, and timing reserved for members. Email signup at https://hollywoodsaleswire.com.
- Audience: salespeople and vendors selling cameras, stages, software, localization, post-production, payroll, insurance, and other products/services into film, TV, and streaming production.
- Method: reads state tax-credit award lists (e.g. California's expanded program, 170 productions and $6.6 billion awarded in its first year), public filings, and careers-page hiring patterns that reveal production buildouts before purchase orders are issued.
- Privacy: the subscriber list is never rented or shared.

## Pages

- [Home / full briefing description](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/): what the Wire is, the method, pricing, and the guarantee.
- [Membership & pricing](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/order): individual and team plans with secure Stripe checkout.
- [Articles](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles): free field notes on selling into the production economy.

## Articles

- [Hollywood's Comfortably Numb Herd Mentality](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles/hollywoods-comfortably-numb-herd-mentality): why reading the trades keeps vendors late — the buying signals precede the announcements.
- [How to Find Film Productions Before They Start Buying](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles/find-film-productions-before-they-buy): reading state tax-credit award lists to reach funded buyers early.
- [Why Entertainment Industry Lead Lists Go Stale](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles/why-entertainment-lead-lists-go-stale): the structural staleness and rental problems with purchased directories, and fresher public alternatives.
- [Reading Hiring Signals](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles/hiring-signals-predict-production-purchases): how careers pages reveal what productions and studios will buy next.
- [The Greenlight Window](https://hollywoodsaleswire.com/articles/timing-the-greenlight-window): timing sales outreach to the production spending cycle from funding to post.
